steps.title: Four methods
steps.say: A command class overrides the parts it needs. WPILib calls them for you.

steps.title: Open TurnToAngleCommand.java
steps.say: Read the finished one first. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `TurnToAngleCommand` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find the error
steps.say: Find where it works out the **error** and turns it into a motor command. Press I did it when you've spotted it.
